Definition: from G1537 and G4137; to accomplish entirely:--fulfill.
BiblicalUsage: ekplēróō means to fulfil completely. In Acts 13:33, the text says "God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, ekplēróō, I take at face value: to fulfil completely.
RelatedEvents: Paul's Missionary Journeys; Paul Preaches at Pisidian Antioch
